INVITATION FOR REQUEST FOR QUOTATIONS

Tajikistan Resilient Landscape Restoration Project

Printing of III-rd version of Red Book of Tajikistan

Request for Quotations Number: TRLRP-CEP-RB-PRINT-2.3-1226

The Government of the Republic of Tajikistan has received grant funding from the World Bank to implement the “Tajikistan Resilient Landscape Restoration Project” aimed at increasing the area of land under sustainable management in selected districts of Tajikistan, as well as promoting cooperation among Central Asian countries in the restoration of transboundary landscape. Part of the grant funds is intended to finance the following works: Printing of III-rd version of Red Book of Tajikistan.

Interested suppliers must meet the following minimum requirements:

  •  Have experience successfully completing at least one (1) similar contract within the last three (3) years;
  • Provide copies of the participant’s legal organizational documents;
  • A license authorizing the provision of printing services;
  • Provide a certificate from the tax authority at the place of registration confirming the absence of any outstanding taxes or mandatory payments.

Interested companies may obtain an electronic version of the bidding documentation package during working hours from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time.

Bids must be submitted no later than October 23, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. (local time):

via the email address listed below; or in person at the address listed below.

Center for the Implementation of Investment Projects (CIIP)

Mr. Mukhibullo Junaidzoda

Director of the CIIP under the Committee on Environmental Protection 

Address: Republic of Tajikistan, Dushanbe, 77 S. Abdulloev St., 6th floor
